title: ecDNA-driven oncogene super-expressors shape immunoevasive tumor microenvironment
authors: Qiao K; Yang Q; Li T; Chen X; Yazgan Z; Kim YJ; Gilbreath C; Stanley Lim JY; Xie Y; Sun X; Liu Y; Jia Y; Chen ZJ; Huang H; Wu S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ecDNA驱动的癌基因扩增与肿瘤免疫微环境重塑，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ecDNA contributes to cancer genetic heterogeneity through random segregation during mitosis. Emerging evidence links ecDNA to immune evasion, but the mechanism remains elusive. Using genetically engineered mouse models of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), we show that Kras and Myc oncogenes are amplified either on ecDNAs or as homogeneously staining regions (HSRs) on chromosomes. ecDNA-driven tumors are more aggressive in immunocompetent mice. Single-cell transcriptomic and histological analyses reveal that ecDNA-driven tumors rapidly establish an immunoevasive tumor microenvironment (TME), marked by increased myofibroblastic cancer-associated fibroblasts (myCAFs) and reduced T cell infiltration. Mechanistically, ecDNA heterogeneity generates a subset of cancer cells with extremely high Kras expression, termed super-expressors, which secrete amphiregulin to promote myCAF expansion and suppress T cell infiltration. Clonally organized super-expressors establish an immunoevasive niche in the TME from patients with PDAC. Our findings demonstrate a causal role of ecDNA in TME remodeling, offering insights into cancer heterogeneity and immune evasion.
abstract_zh: ecDNA通过有丝分裂过程中的随机分离导致癌症遗传异质性。新兴证据将ecDNA与免疫逃逸联系起来，但其机制仍不明确。利用胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的基因工程小鼠模型，我们显示Kras和Myc癌基因在ecDNA上或染色体上的均质染色区（HSRs）中扩增。在免疫活性小鼠中，ecDNA驱动的肿瘤更具侵袭性。单细胞转录组学和组织学分析揭示，ecDNA驱动的肿瘤迅速建立免疫逃逸的肿瘤微环境（TME），其特征为肌成纤维细胞癌相关成纤维细胞（myCAFs）增加和T细胞浸润减少。机制上，ecDNA异质性产生了一类具有极高Kras表达的癌细胞亚群，称为超表达细胞，其分泌双调蛋白以促进myCAF扩张并抑制T细胞浸润。克隆组织的超表达细胞在PDAC患者的TME中建立了免疫逃逸生态位。我们的发现证明了ecDNA在TME重塑中的因果作用，为癌症异质性和免疫逃逸提供了见解。
